prompt: To check whether a die is fair, a student rolls it $120$ times and records how often each face appears. In a chi-square goodness-of-fit test, what is the EXPECTED count for each face?

hints.text: A fair die gives each face probability $\frac{1}{6}$. Multiply by $120$.

explanation: $H_0$: the die is fair, so each face has probability $1/6$.
Expected count for a category is $n p_i = 120 \times 1/6$.
Each face is expected $20$ times. The test compares the observed counts to these 20s.

alternativeExplanations.title: Share equally
steps: Observed counts will wobble around 20; the chi-square statistic measures how much.
